content: {"praised":["Writing is superb.","Actors portray roles perfectly.","Humor between Harvey and Mike is great.","Show revolves around a law firm, engaging.","Learning about negotiations and legal process."],"criticized":["Same characters and storylines as first season.","Premise too thin to support 16 episodes.","Episodes no longer self-standing, start with ‘Previously on’.","New characters shallow and one-dimensional.","Format change irritating."]}
